name: Retribution Domain
body:
Deity: Bast or other deities of revenge or vengeance, avengers of the wronged

Granted Powers: Your touch can fill enemies with Bast’s retribution, and you can smite foes with a retributive strike.

Retributive Touch (Su): You can touch a creature as a melee touch attack. If your touch attack is successful, you fill your foe’s mind with visions of retribution, leaving them with the shaken condition for 1 round.

Retributive Strike (Su): At 8th level, once per day you can strike the ground with your fist or with a melee weapon. From the point of your strike, you release a 30 ft. burst of powerful force energy, dealing 8d4 points of damage to all foes within the burst. Those affected may make a Reflex save for half damage. The DC to resist the damage is 10 + ½ your cleric level + your Charisma bonus. Anyone you normally consider a friend or ally is not affected by the retributive strike.

Domain Spells: 1st—divine strike, 2nd—retribution, 3rd—bestow curse, 4th—greater retribution, 5th—mark of justice, 6th—geas/quest, 7th—destruction, 8th—holy aura, 9th—storm of vengeance.
